updates.title: Introducing workspace agents in ChatGPT
updates.summary: OpenAI 于 2026-04-22 推出 workspace agents，把 GPT 从个人使用场景推进到组织级共享 agent：可运行长任务、遵循团队流程、在 ChatGPT 与 Slack 中复用，并在企业权限控制内运行。

raw_source.evidence: OpenAI official product post announcing workspace agents in ChatGPT for Business, Enterprise, Edu, and Teachers plans.

updates.title: Speeding up agentic workflows with WebSockets in the Responses API
updates.summary: OpenAI 于 2026-04-22 说明其通过 WebSockets、缓存和栈级优化，把基于 Responses API 的 agent loop 端到端提速 40%，释放出更适合长链路 agent 工作流的开发者基础设施信号。

raw_source.evidence: OpenAI engineering post states agent loops using the API became 40% faster end-to-end via WebSockets and related optimizations.

updates.title: Introducing OpenAI Privacy Filter
updates.summary: OpenAI 于 2026-04-22 发布开源权重的 Privacy Filter，用于识别和脱敏文本中的个人身份信息，支持本地运行、单次高吞吐处理，并以 Apache 2.0 许可开放给开发者定制。

raw_source.evidence: OpenAI research/security post presents Privacy Filter as an open-weight model for context-aware PII detection and redaction.

updates.title: Making ChatGPT better for clinicians
updates.summary: OpenAI 于 2026-04-22 推出面向美国认证临床人员免费开放的 ChatGPT for Clinicians，把文档、医学研究与临床问答纳入专门产品线，并同步强调 HIPAA 支持、医生评审与开放健康基准。

raw_source.evidence: OpenAI product post says ChatGPT for Clinicians is free for verified clinicians in the U.S. and highlights safety review plus HealthBench Professional.

updates.title: Google DeepMind partners with global consultancies to accelerate enterprise AI adoption
updates.summary: Google DeepMind 于 2026-04-22 宣布与 Accenture、Bain、BCG、Deloitte、McKinsey 等咨询公司合作推动企业采用 Gemini，提醒人们企业 AI 竞争不仅在模型与产品，还在实施与分发网络。

raw_source.evidence: Google DeepMind official blog post dated April 22, 2026 announces consultancy partnerships to close the enterprise AI adoption gap.
